verify.name: content-parses
verify.expect: all five suites OK, each naming how much it examined (posts, blockquotes, html nodes, text nodes, island-guard slug/settings-path/island-name cases)
verify.why: Aggregates check:content, check:blockquotes, check:sanitize, check:smartypants and check:island-guard. Each asserts it ran over a non-empty corpus — a Tina collection, a Vale glob and an embed counter have all reported success over nothing on this branch.

verify.name: tina-indexes-posts
verify.why: `tinacms audit` prints '✅ Audit passed' and exits 0 on an EMPTY collection, so the counts must be asserted explicitly. A wrong collection path/format/glob would otherwise build all 59 pages with no posts, exit 0, and deploy. Asserts per-collection since Task 2.1: the script fails if a named collection is missing from the audit, if a count is wrong, AND if the audit reports a collection nobody asserted — so adding the Task 3.1 `page` collection without extending this command fails the gate instead of silently narrowing it.

verify.name: build-and-routes
verify.command: bun run build:local && find dist/client -name '*.html' | sed 's|^dist/client||' | sort | diff .baseline/routes.txt -
verify.expect: only difference is an added /admin/index.html (the TinaCMS admin SPA); all 59 site routes present
verify.why: `bun run build` alone fails without a Tina server — use build:local. Output moved to dist/client + dist/server when the Cloudflare adapter landed, so the route diff must target dist/client. Tina's datalayer binds 9000 and its client hardcodes localhost:4001; the scripts pin --datalayer-port 9007. Both scripts also set NODE_ENV=production, because `tinacms build` otherwise runs its subcommand with NODE_ENV=development, which folds import.meta.env.DEV to true and compiles postFilter to `return true` — publishing every draft and scheduled post.

verify.name: prose
verify.expect: 0 errors — and check the trailing 'in N files' count is 17, not 0
verify.why: Vale reports success on an empty file set. The .vale.ini glob is extension-scoped, so renaming posts silently pointed it at zero files once already.

verify.name: lint
verify.expect: fails ONLY on DESIGN.json, src/utils/og-templates/post.js, src/utils/og-templates/site.js — all pre-existing on main. src/components/Header.astro was on this list until Task 2.1; its only complaint was a missing blank line after the imports, which the settings-prop edit supplied.
verify.why: Not a clean gate. Any file outside that list appearing is a regression introduced by this branch.
